title: Require the second factor after password reset
action: After reset, issue only a restricted recovery state until MFA or a governed recovery process completes. Store authentication assurance per session and require it for admin access and security changes.
acceptance: With ADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED on, resetting an MFA-enabled admin password cannot access any admin endpoint before step-up. Test ordinary MFA users, old sessions, reused links, recovery codes and MFA disable/recovery-code regeneration.
implementation_status: Implemented: password reset revokes sessions; MFA assurance is required for enrolled sessions and office access; security changes require a fresh factor.

title: Apply relationship checks to participant photos
action: Use one object-level photo permission policy: owner, appropriately scoped active helper, authorised care relationship, or authorised office role. Re-evaluate on every request.
acceptance: An unrelated participant and unrelated worker receive no image; authorised roles succeed; revoked helpers and ended care relationships lose access under the agreed policy.
implementation_status: Implemented: participant photo access uses owner, active helper scope, care relationship and office permissions; private/no-store responses.

title: Respect unpublished worker photo visibility
action: Only serve a public worker photo while the public-profile policy permits publication. Provide private owner/office access separately and define withdrawal/cache handling.
acceptance: Draft, withdrawn and closed worker profiles have no anonymous photo access; published eligible profiles do. Test cache behaviour after withdrawal.
implementation_status: Implemented: public worker photos require a publishable eligible profile; closed or withdrawn profiles lose anonymous access.

title: Correct incident reporting clocks and completion workflow
action: Have the safeguarding lead approve a versioned rule table. Capture occurred time, provider awareness, harm and category separately. Support notification, five-day submission and any separately requested final report, each with evidence and owner. Correct UI, email, training and generated agreements together.
acceptance: Fixtures cover retrospective entry, restrictive practice with and without harm, weekends/time zones and any applicable holiday definition; filing records reference/time/actor and stops only the correct reminder; overdue cases remain visible until their obligations are resolved.
implementation_status: Implemented: awareness/harm-based deadlines, separate five-day/final-report evidence, immutable event history and incomplete-obligation closure gate. Safeguarding lead must review migrated incidents and the real procedure.

title: Enforce the same evidence rules on every verification endpoint
action: Move evidence, method, revision and expiry rules into a shared server-side verification service used by all admin entry points. Make any legitimate non-upload issuer evidence an explicit, auditable path.
acceptance: Legacy and new APIs cannot approve missing evidence or a stale revision implicitly; explicit issuer-based evidence, if allowed, has a required source and review record. Concurrent replacement invalidates the old decision.
implementation_status: Implemented: shared evidence/revision checks on legacy and workspace verification routes; missing files and stale decisions are refused.

title: Reject empty or weak production signing secrets
action: Validate the actual selected secret content and minimum strength before listening; fail closed on empty, unreadable or invalid content, and document rotation/recovery.
acceptance: Production startup rejects empty, whitespace-only and inadequate secrets; accepts an appropriately generated secret; precedence and rotation tests cover both environment and file configuration without printing secrets.
implementation_status: Implemented: production checks the selected secret, including empty env/file values, short and predictably repeated values.

title: Include every referenced file in backup completeness checks
action: Maintain a schema-wide file reference inventory, including policy_pages. Flag missing files and paths outside archived roots, then perform a clean restore drill of database, documents, photos and required secret/config recovery.
acceptance: A deliberately missing policy source and an out-of-root reference fail completeness validation. A clean restore opens samples from every file-bearing table and meets an owner-approved recovery objective.
implementation_status: Implemented: all discovered file-bearing columns participate in backup completeness; missing policies/outside roots fail. Actual off-instance restore remains an external acceptance step.

title: Document the applicable digital-platform registration pathway
action: Have the accountable provider verify the final applicable rules and its own registration/transition evidence. Reconcile advertised services, certificate groups and actual delivery scope before accepting participants.
acceptance: A dated signed launch decision identifies the legal entity, certificate/groups, conditions, applicable transition basis and permitted services. Public claims match that evidence.
implementation_status: External evidence required: actual certificate, conditions, services and current digital-platform registration pathway must be confirmed by the provider. Acceptance template and in-app evidence register supplied.

title: Check automatic pricing against actual service agreements
basis: Automatic calculation plus business acceptance evidence; not an invoice gate
action: Verify automatic NSW holiday/time-band calculations and actual agreement/tax settings using representative cases. Correct only genuinely missing or inconsistent charge data. Routine approved visits issue automatically without an A09 sign-off.
acceptance: An independent billing reviewer signs expected amounts for weekdays, weekends, holidays, midnight, DST, sleepovers, active overnight time, cancellation, travel and funding types. Compare invoices and calculator/public prices against the same fixtures.
implementation_status: Replaced blanket finance/holiday and boundary holds in v88.3.2 with automatic NSW calendars, itemised date/time pricing, immediate approval-triggered invoice processing and a durable retry queue. Actual invalid/stale edited charges remain visible exceptions. Financial specialist acceptance of business agreements and configured tax/payroll remains an operating responsibility, not a per-invoice software gate.

title: Validate full employment entitlements outside the booking share calculation
action: Reconcile actual employment arrangements with an award-capable payroll process. Include ordinary hours, overtime, broken shifts, sleepovers, rest, minimum engagements, allowances and super treatment where applicable; retain a separate finance approval.
acceptance: A payroll specialist signs sample rosters, including work before/after a sleepover under the June 2026 changes. CSV amounts map unambiguously to wages, super and allowances, with corrections and external payment evidence.
implementation_status: Implemented guarded payroll: booking figures labelled estimates; every included line requires reviewed gross wages, super, allowances and calculation reference; separate approver. Full entitlements remain the external payroll specialist’s calculation.

title: Complete the essential journeys on the deployed website
action: Use the existing prelaunch website for participant, helper, worker and office journeys on the devices people will use. Confirm actual email and payment-provider outcomes. Run recovery drills against an isolated copy so the website is not overwritten.
acceptance: Record the essential journey outcomes, devices and any important barriers with their fixes and retest. Confirm actual provider delivery and payment results; retain a recovery procedure. Local automated tests are evidence of code behaviour, not proof of live integrations.
implementation_status: Local automated release checks have passed on Node 22.23.2. Actual deployed-browser and provider outcomes need their own evidence; a separate permanent test website is not required.

title: Keep external calendars consistent with voided visits
action: Share the same visit visibility policy and track cancellation tombstones for previously exported events. Include relevant visibility changes in the event revision signature.
acceptance: A voided event never appears as confirmed; previous subscribers receive a cancellation/update with stable UID and increasing sequence. Reassignment, closure, expiry and token revocation are covered.
implementation_status: Implemented: voided/reassigned visits retain stable cancellation tombstones and sequences in subscribed calendars.

title: Deliver time-sensitive booking requests before they become stale
action: Carry event kind, visit time and response deadline as structured metadata. Let people choose suitable urgent channels and routine digests, and escalate unacknowledged imminent requests to the office.
acceptance: A request whose response deadline precedes the next digest is delivered or escalated in time under the approved contact policy; routine notices stay batched; duplicates, quiet periods, changed visits and opt-outs behave predictably.
implementation_status: Implemented: structured time-sensitive requests bypass digests; resolved/expired requests are rechecked before transport; routine digest scheduling retained.

title: Define partial payment, refund and dispute lifecycles
action: Use an auditable invoice/payment ledger for partial receipts, reversals, credits and refunds, or document and test the approved external process before offering those cases. Keep provider transaction IDs and reconciliation ownership.
acceptance: A partial payment leaves the correct balance; duplicate/out-of-order events do not double-settle; refund and dispute outcomes reconcile without changing original invoice history.
implementation_status: Implemented: partial receipts, outstanding balances, immutable signed amounts, idempotent checkout evidence, independently approved reversals and provider refund/dispute reconciliation queue. Provider sandbox settlement remains external.

title: Verify actual email delivery and escalation
action: Validate sender authentication and provider delivery events. Expose failed/old essential messages to an owned office queue with a manual contact fallback.
acceptance: Staging demonstrates accepted, bounced, retried and permanently failed messages; each critical failure has an owner; logs exclude message bodies and sensitive tokens.
implementation_status: Implemented: transport acceptance is distinguished from delivery; actual delivery/bounce/failure evidence and owned fallback follow-up can be recorded. Real mailbox/provider drill required.

title: Monitor dependencies and job freshness beyond database liveness
action: Add separate authenticated operational checks for storage, queue age, failed jobs, backup age and certificate expiry. Define alerts, on-call ownership and a manual continuity procedure.
acceptance: Synthetic disk-full, mail failure, missed backup and stopped job conditions create actionable alerts; public health endpoints do not reveal private operational detail.
implementation_status: Implemented: private operational checks for writable/free storage, job freshness/failure, ageing mail, complete local backup evidence, imminent unanswered visits and automatic HTTPS certificate monitoring with retries. Confirm that the responsible person receives actual alerts and that off-instance backups can be restored.

title: Test complete tasks to WCAG 2.2 AA with assistive technology
action: Audit keyboard order, focus visibility, dialogs, errors, live updates, redundant entry and accessible authentication. Test with disabled participants and workers; preserve sufficient hit areas while reducing visual bulk.
acceptance: No critical task blocks keyboard/screen-reader use; 200–400% zoom and narrow reflow avoid hidden actions; focus is not obscured; target size and alternatives meet the applicable WCAG criteria.
implementation_status: Retained accessible controls and added focus/target/reflow styles for new screens. Assistive-technology task acceptance remains external; supplied keyboard, zoom and screen-reader matrix.

title: Stabilise header, menus, route focus and scroll
basis: Historical complaint; current browser check needed
action: Keep three or four frequent destinations per role, one account menu and consistent page titles. Test delayed data, back navigation, keyboard expansion and the largest accessibility text setting on every layout.
acceptance: No overlap at 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440 CSS pixels; worker Settings > Credentials remains in credentials; ordinary navigation starts at the intended top and back returns predictably.
implementation_status: Retained previous header/menu/route-scroll fixes and regression coverage. Direct calendar-return date and scoped render checks added. Actual device layout remains external.

title: Prove previews and per-file actions across supported formats
action: Maintain a fixture pack for rotated, multi-page, encrypted, corrupt and large PDFs, PNG/JPEG and accepted HTML agreements. Keep compact preview controls, explicit errors, accessible text and original download.
acceptance: Worker and participant originals open in all supported browsers; unsupported/encrypted/corrupt files show recovery rather than endless loading; replace targets one file, remove explains consequences, and previews cannot execute uploaded scripts.
implementation_status: Retained local PDF/HTML/image viewer and exact-file controls; 46 verification scenarios cover access/actions. Real supported-browser preview fixture matrix supplied.

title: Make unsupported high-intensity needs an owned pre-visit handoff
action: Record who will deliver each excluded activity, the participant’s agreement, contact and timing. Require a qualified reviewer to decide whether the remaining visit can safely proceed; provide an escalation path on the day.
acceptance: A scenario with essential excluded support cannot silently reach a visit without an owned, reviewed arrangement. Workers can immediately see what they may do and who to contact.
implementation_status: Implemented: named excluded-support arrangements with independent review; plan/visit changes invalidate approval; acceptance paths check readiness; worker brief and office tasks show the arrangement.

title: Complete the data and retention inventory, including external processors
action: Document purposes, access roles, retention triggers, legal holds, exports, backup deletion and processor contracts. Assess Privacy Act applicability and relevant state obligations with the actual service model.
acceptance: Every sensitive data class has an accountable owner and a documented retention/access rule. A sample access/correction/closure request is completed consistently across live data, exports and retained backups.
implementation_status: Supplied table-group/data-flow/processor inventory, legal-hold and retention decision procedure, evidence fields and deletion/restore test. Actual retention periods/contracts require provider confirmation.

title: Treat the Australian region setting as a declaration, not proof
basis: Source gap; only relevant if AI enabled
action: Keep AI disabled until a provider-specific assessment verifies endpoint, regions, retention, training use, subprocessors and contract controls. Validate outbound destinations and minimise/redact data.
acceptance: An arbitrary endpoint cannot become approved solely by an au region label. A documented provider pilot verifies no unapproved data use; declining AI leaves the full manual workflow available.
implementation_status: Implemented: exact endpoint allowlist plus current provider/model/region assessment, consent gate and blocked redirects/private destinations. Real provider contractual/data-location evidence remains external.

title: Commission an independent access-control and application security review
action: Use OWASP ASVS 5 as a structured verification basis, with a level appropriate to sensitive personal data. Cover each role, helper scope, revoked access, uploads, sessions, exports and payment transitions.
acceptance: A reviewer records results and remediation evidence for the selected ASVS controls and a negative permission matrix; security-critical defects are retested independently.
implementation_status: Independent security review remains external. Supplied ASVS/object-access/recovery/export test scope and evidence register; synthetic regressions are not a penetration test.

title: Measure capacity and failure behaviour on the deployed architecture
action: Load test mixed login, search, booking, upload and admin workloads on the intended instance. Measure event-loop delay, memory, database lock waits and response percentiles; test storage and provider failures.
acceptance: An agreed launch traffic profile passes without lost/duplicated writes; uploads and login bursts do not stall care-critical pages; capacity thresholds and scale-up steps are documented.
implementation_status: Deployed capacity acceptance remains external. Supplied load/failure profiles, invariant checks, recovery thresholds and escalation procedure.

title: Separate approval of money movements from preparation
action: Introduce permission-scoped finance roles or a documented second-person sign-off for launch, with no shared admin account. Require evidence before marking external payment complete.
acceptance: Preparation and approval are attributable; high-impact adjustments require an independent review under the agreed policy; exported totals reconcile to the external payment run.
implementation_status: Implemented: payroll preparers/line reviewers cannot approve their batch; reversals require a different approver and once-only consumption. Separate named office accounts required.

title: Show one actionable task per obligation with clear ownership
basis: Design improvement; current grouping already present
action: Use one title, why it matters, deadline and primary action; show who acts next. Replace completed groups with a neutral confirmation. Make urgency reflect an actual deadline or blocked service.
acceptance: In moderated testing, people can explain their next action and distinguish missing, received, under review and verified without office help; completing one obligation removes its duplicates everywhere.
implementation_status: Retained grouped actionable tasks, office/person separation and ownership; added operational and excluded-support obligations to office tasks. User cohort validation remains external.

title: Use a short resumable path and reuse confirmed details
action: Ask only what the next stage requires. Display the source/date of reused answers, offer review-and-confirm for existing details, and preserve drafts across sessions with explicit saved/unsaved state.
acceptance: A participant and a worker resume on another device without re-entering confirmed basics; edits flow to the intended source of truth and never overwrite a newer plan silently.
implementation_status: Implemented account-revision guard and updated form; retained resumable intake, contact-only updates and authoritative Settings links.

title: Make essential missing files immediately scannable
basis: Design improvement; catalogue and per-file actions present
action: Put required missing/returned/expired items first with the specific action. Use neutral received/under-review states and clearly labelled verified status. Keep the full document-type selector searchable and secondary.
acceptance: Workers identify all missing essentials immediately, upload directly to the correct category, and replace a selected file without duplicating it. Status is understandable without colour.
implementation_status: Implemented missing-first essential checklist and document-type search while retaining all 25 types and exact-file actions.

title: Reduce review clicks while preserving decision quality
action: Use an unread/changed evidence queue, compact document list, persistent preview and a single review panel. Prepopulate reusable issuer/reference fields only when traceable; offer keyboard next-item navigation and exception grouping.
acceptance: Measure review time and correction rate on representative clean/expired/ambiguous records. Every decision still records actor, method, evidence version and rationale; no hidden auto-approval.
implementation_status: Implemented session-opened evidence markers and non-submitting Alt-arrow navigation; retained guided review, current-evidence guard and draft preservation.

title: Give each visit one stable detail destination
action: Use one stable visit URL and shared state across calendar, next actions, messages and approval inbox. Keep month overview, compact day agenda and list alternative; return to the selected day.
acceptance: Accept, query, note and cancel routes open the correct visit for the current role; back navigation restores the same day/filter without hiding another calendar date.
implementation_status: Implemented calendar-to-visit workspace links with selected-date return and existing List controls available.

title: Explain match quality and offer practical alternatives
action: Show why a worker matches, the nearest eligible times, travel area and what information is still unconfirmed. Provide saved preferences and office help when no suitable match exists.
acceptance: No-result testing offers useful alternatives without exposing private addresses or proposing unavailable/unqualified workers; users can explain the ordering.
implementation_status: Retained requested-interval/service/area matching explanations and practical alternative-date API; clarified interpretation in guide. User validation of matching quality remains a measured research task.

title: Keep active participant and permission boundaries visible
action: Keep a clear acting-for banner on every mutable client page, use explicit permission summaries and make revocation understandable. Confirm sensitive changes using the active person’s name.
acceptance: A helper switches among clients with different scopes without stale data or misdirected writes; revocation during an open form produces a clear recovery message.
implementation_status: Implemented permitted-scope text in the acting-for banner; retained explicit participant selection, stop control and server-side per-request grants.

title: Improve note reliability under poor connectivity
action: Make server-confirmed save status and last-saved time prominent. Provide controlled recovery/retry and an agreed offline policy; avoid indefinitely caching sensitive records on shared devices.
acceptance: Network interruption, tab closure and duplicate completion are tested; note content is recovered within the agreed privacy policy and only one authoritative completion is created.
implementation_status: Implemented saved/recovered timestamps and explicit draft retry without shift completion; retained draft conflicts, failure messages and close warning. No offline persistence promise.

title: Separate evidence receipt, module completion and competence
action: Label each evidence type, renewal requirement and assessor decision. Surface only role-relevant outstanding modules and link each requirement to its reason.
acceptance: Workers and reviewers can tell which tasks are mandatory for their offered services and whether completion, source checking or competence assessment is still required.
implementation_status: Retained distinct uploaded evidence and Training records; clarified competence/scope limitations in guide and review instructions. Worker-specific skill assessment remains human.

title: Keep referral rewards easy to find and unambiguous
action: Retain one labelled referral entry under the account area, with link/share, qualification steps and reward history. Keep earnings estimates distinct from approved and paid amounts.
acceptance: A worker locates referrals from settings/account and sees pending, qualified and paid states consistent with the finance record; self/duplicate referrals are handled clearly.
implementation_status: Retained direct Refer a friend shortcut and Earnings access; guide distinguishes qualifying rewards, reviewed batch and externally acknowledged payment.

title: Audit public promises and make help contextual
action: Maintain one source for operational/legal facts and a review date/owner. Add contextual help for blocked tasks, complaint access and urgent contact information in care workflows.
acceptance: A content inventory reconciles prices, registration, refunds/cancellation, response times and scope across all outputs. Users can find an appropriate human contact from a failed task.
implementation_status: Corrected affected help/manual and legacy payroll labels; public-claims inspection inventory and owner sign-off procedure supplied. Registration/price promises still need actual provider evidence.

title: Consolidate domain rules and make risky changes independently testable
action: Extract authentication, permissions, verification, time/rates and incident state transitions into shared domain services with focused negative tests. Reduce inline script gradually and tighten CSP when feasible.
acceptance: All callers use the same decision functions; browser/API tests prove old paths cannot skip policy; release checks include the newly discovered regressions.
implementation_status: Implemented shared evidence, incident, photo/session, billing-review and ledger policies with focused regressions; original assignment/permission services retained.

title: Track the runtime and vendored assets as dependencies
action: Maintain an asset/version/license register and a scheduled advisory review. Verify hashes and supported runtimes; pin updates and run the real document fixture suite on upgrades.
acceptance: Each vendored component has a provenance/version and owner; alerts are triaged; the declared Node version is tested before release. No current vulnerability is asserted solely from version age.
implementation_status: Supplied dependency provenance and hashes for the runtime declaration, lockfile, PDF.js, fonts and other vendors. Local automated release checks have passed on Node 22.23.2; confirm the deployed runtime and keep advisory reviews current.

title: Offer passkeys after repairing recovery
action: Pilot standards-based passkeys with staff first, then offer an optional accessible path for workers/participants. Retain governed recovery and an appropriate fallback.
acceptance: Sign-in, device replacement, recovery, revocation and shared-device scenarios pass; measure completion and support burden rather than assuming universal adoption.
implementation_status: Research option, not implemented: passkey pilot specification and recovery/accessibility acceptance supplied. TOTP/recovery fixes ship now; no untested authentication method enabled.

title: Pilot document extraction as reviewable suggestions
action: After privacy approval, start with non-sensitive fixtures and then consented worker records. Show extracted text alongside the source; flag low-confidence fields and never convert extraction into identity or clearance approval.
acceptance: Measure field accuracy by document type, correction time, abstention and failure rate; replacements invalidate stale suggestions; manual upload always works.
implementation_status: Governed document-suggestion pilot specification supplied; actual assistance stays off until assessed/configured/consented. Existing review/edit/discard flow retained.

title: Test reminders for usefulness and access, not just volume
action: After fixing urgent delivery, pilot neutral reminders with confirmation, reschedule/help and chosen channel/timing. Do not penalise disability-related barriers or rank people by opaque risk scores.
acceptance: Compare acknowledgement, missed visits, opt-outs, assistance requests and staff workload; report denominators and subgroup experience. Stop a variant if complaints or access barriers worsen.
implementation_status: Reminder pilot specification supplied with delivery, accessibility, resolution and opt-out measures; urgent request correction ships now.

title: Test optional worker-authored note assistance cautiously
action: Prefer an optional draft from a worker’s own structured observations, after privacy and clinical review. Keep original observations, require human correction/sign-off and prohibit invented care facts.
acceptance: A governed pilot compares time saved, omissions, factual errors and participant experience. No autonomous incident judgement, medication instruction or unreviewed signed note is produced.
implementation_status: Research option, not implemented: worker-authored note-assistance protocol supplied. No generated clinical notes or automatic shift completion enabled.

title: Measure usability with participants and workers before expanding features
action: Run paid, accessible research sessions covering new/returning users and assistive technology. Track task completion, time, errors, requests for help and unresolved office waits, with a recorded response to each finding.
acceptance: A small launch cohort completes the essential journeys; every critical barrier has an owner and retest; the team publishes an internal decision log showing which user feedback changed the product.
implementation_status: Real participant/worker usability cohort and measures remain external; concrete moderated tasks, accessible materials and decision log supplied.

title: Make the endpoint inventory complete and syntax-tolerant
action: Generate the inventory from actual registration metadata or a syntax-aware parser, preserving regular-expression grouping, and include pre-dispatch handlers explicitly.
acceptance: The document-assistance endpoint appears in the inventory; harmless whitespace does not change the count; the generated list matches registered routes and all pre-dispatch surfaces have an assigned access policy.
implementation_status: Implemented inventory from actually registered routes during disposable boot, plus pre-dispatch handlers; spacing and independently mounted modules no longer drop routes.
